wages.text: She said she supports raising the federal minimum wage to keep pace with rising prices.
wages.quote: Strange said she would support ending Trump’s tariffs, as well as raising the federal minimum wage to better keep pace with inflating prices.

schools.text: She said she would invest in public education from pre-K through graduation and provide schools with needed resources.
schools.quote: I’ll invest in strong public education from Pre-K through graduation and help schools get the resources they need.

immigration.text: She supports due process and a pathway to citizenship for immigrants and refugees, and says ICE should be abolished.
immigration.quote: For our immigrant and refugee populations, this includes affording them due process and a pathway to citizenship that is achievable in a reasonable amount of time.

abortion.text: She supports federal protection of reproductive rights and access to reproductive and related health care.
abortion.quote: She supports protecting reproductive rights at the federal level to ensure that access to care isn’t determined by geography.

voting.text: She supports expanding voting access, modernizing voter registration, and measures that make participation easier.
voting.quote: I’ll fight to expand voting access by protecting and modernizing voter registration, supporting measures that make it easier to participate

tax.text: His campaign says he would cut taxes, reduce regulations, and curb spending.
tax.quote: Ed Gallrein will work to cut taxes, reduce regulations, stop the reckless spending that has driven up inflation, and fight to bring good-paying jobs back home for Kentucky.

wages.text: He opposes government mandates to raise the minimum wage and favors competitive markets.
wages.quote: I oppose government mandates to raise the minimum wage. Businesses and customers are already saddled with enough costs thanks to rising inflation and bureaucratic red tape. The best way to raise wages is free enterprise and competitive markets.

schools.text: He strongly supports allowing education dollars to follow children to schools their parents choose.
schools.quote: I support a constitutional amendment that would allow Kentucky’s General Assembly to set up a school choice program to allow dollars to follow children to the school of their choice.

immigration.text: His campaign supports completing the border wall and fully funding Border Patrol and ICE.
immigration.quote: Gallrein will team up with President Trump and the Republican Party to finish the wall, fully fund Border Patrol & ICE, secure the border once and for all

guns.text: He says he would protect the right to keep and bear arms without compromise.
guns.quote: Gallrein will protect our right to keep and bear arms without compromise and back the blue.

abortion.text: His campaign describes him as pro-life and says he wants to protect the unborn.
abortion.quote: As a Navy SEAL, grandfather and father, Conservative Ed Gallrein knows firsthand how precious life is. Gallrein is Pro-Life!

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agrees that biological males should not participate in women's sports or enter women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: He supports keeping Medicaid and Medicare available but opposes additional taxpayer-funded health programs.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary.

tax.text: He disagreed that higher earners should pay more taxes to provide relief for working families and described taxes as a problem.
tax.quote: Taxes are the problem, not the solution. If you took every dollar of wealth from every billionaire it would fund the federal government for a few month.

trade.text: He supports a free and open marketplace for goods, services, and trade with less government interference.
trade.quote: America and humanity as a whole is being held back by an ever-expanding system of government regulation, interference, and centralized control over what should be a free and open marketplace of goods, services, ideas, innovation, and trade.

debt.text: He supported cutting government spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: Endless money printing and crippling debt are making it nearly impossible for everyday people to get ahead. It feels like the American dream is being taken away from our children and grandchildren before they even have a chance to reach for it. I am standing up to fight this because we cannot let our future generations inherit a burden they did not create. If we do not bring down the debt we will not survive another century.

immigration.text: He supports legal immigration and a fair process while also favoring secure, clearly enforced borders.
immigration.quote: a free society should remain open to legal, orderly immigration while also maintaining secure and clearly enforced borders.

guns.text: He said there should be no restrictions on gun ownership for public safety.
guns.quote: Absolutely none. Self defense is a right that shall not be infringed.

abortion.text: He said elective abortion should be allowed only when complications require protecting the mother's life.
abortion.quote: Only in cases where complications require protection of the life of the mother and life saving care should be delivered to the child in every attempt to save its life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports and said women's sports should be for biological women.
gender.quote: All individuals have been able to participate in co-ed sports as well as men's sports and that should remain. Women's sports should be for biological women only.

health.text: Todd rejects entitlement to taxpayer-funded health care and favors voluntary rather than tax-funded assistance.
health.quote: Ultimately I do not believe anyone is entitled to have someone else pay for their healthcare.

voting.text: He supports the SAVE Act's requirement that people show proof of citizenship when registering for federal elections.
voting.quote: The SAVE Act simply requires proof of citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections.
